headline: China's official manufacturing PMI returns to expansion at 50.1 in September

supports: China's official manufacturing PMI rose to 50.1 in September from 49.8 in August.
The September reading ended two consecutive months of contraction.
China's official manufacturing PMI rose to 50.1 in September from 49.8 in August.

caption:
🇺🇸 China's official manufacturing PMI rose to 50.1 in September from 49.8 in August, returning above the 50-point line that separates expansion from contraction after two consecutive months below it. Reuters and the Associated Press independently reported the same official figures.

🇪🇸 El PMI manufacturero oficial de China subió a 50.1 en septiembre desde 49.8 en agosto, regresando por encima del nivel de 50 que separa expansión de contracción después de dos meses consecutivos por debajo de ese nivel. Reuters y Associated Press reportaron de forma independiente las mismas cifras oficiales.

Sources: Reuters / Associated Press — Sept. 30, 2026.
